description: This file provides an asynchronous utility function 'withTempDir' that creates a temporary directory with specified options, executes a callback within that directory, and then cleans up the temporary directory afterward.

methods.name: export async function withTempDir<T>( withTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory based on provided options, runs an asynchronous callback within this directory, and then cleans up the directory after execution.

ctags.name: base
ctags.pattern: /^  const base = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(options.parentDir ?? os.tmpdir(), options.prefix));$/

ctags.name: dir
ctags.pattern: /^  const dir = options.subdir ? path.join(base, options.subdir) : base;$/

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^  const dir = options.subdir ? path.join(base, options.subdir) : base;$/
